title: Blower motor fault
shortDescription: Hood blower not running at commanded speed.
fullDescription: Dacor range hoods display E1 when the blower tachometer feedback does not match the commanded speed. Cause is usually grease build-up on the impeller, a failed capacitor, or worn motor bearings.

fixSteps.title: Clean impeller
fixSteps.instruction: Remove filters, soak; degrease blower wheel.

whenToCallPro: If cleaning fails or motor needs replacement.

title: Heat sensor over-temperature
shortDescription: Hood heat sensor detected excessive cooktop temperature.
fullDescription: E2 means the heat sentry sensor has detected the cooktop heat exceeding safe limits. The hood will auto-run on high until temperature drops.
symptoms: Hood runs on high without input

fixSteps.title: Reduce heat
fixSteps.instruction: Lower burner output and let hood ventilate.

whenToCallPro: If sensor is suspected of false alerts.
videoSearchQuery: Dacor range hood E2 heat sensor

title: Filter saturation alert
shortDescription: Hours of operation indicate filters need cleaning.
fullDescription: E3 is a maintenance reminder that the grease filters or recirculating charcoal filter has reached its service interval.

fixSteps.title: Wash filters
fixSteps.instruction: Run grease filters in dishwasher; replace charcoal.

videoSearchQuery: Dacor range hood E3 filter reset

faq.a: Grease every month, charcoal every 6 months.

title: Light circuit fault
shortDescription: Halogen or LED lighting circuit overcurrent.
fullDescription: E4 indicates a short or overcurrent on the lighting circuit. Replace any blown bulbs and inspect the lamp socket harness.

title: Damper fault
fullDescription: E5 means the motorized backdraft damper did not actuate when the blower started. Inspect for grease binding the flap or a failed actuator motor.

fixSteps.title: Clean damper
fixSteps.instruction: Access duct collar and degrease damper flap.

title: Touch panel error
fullDescription: E6 indicates a touch button reads continuously pressed. Wipe the panel and reset.

fixSteps.title: Clean panel
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe touch surface with mild degreaser.

whenToCallPro: Only if clean and reset fail.
videoSearchQuery: Dacor range hood E6 touch panel

title: Remote sensor lost
fullDescription: E7 reports loss of communication with the optional wireless heat sensor or remote control receiver. Replace battery or re-pair.

faq.a: Yes, all hood functions remain on the panel.

title: Power supply low voltage
fullDescription: E8 indicates input voltage dropped below threshold. Check the dedicated branch circuit and any GFCI in line.

title: Control board fault
fullDescription: E9 means the main hood control failed its internal self-test. Replace the control board.

faq.a: No firmware update fixes hardware faults.

title: Sensor calibration
fullDescription: E0 is shown briefly after a power-up while the auto-mode sensors calibrate. It clears within ~30 seconds. Persistent E0 means a sensor failure.
whenToCallPro: Only if E0 persists past 5 minutes.
